sn12.3:1.2: [the Exalted One said]:— “I will teach you, Monks, both the wrong way and the tight way.
sn12.3:1.3: Listen to it, give your minds thoroughly and I will speak.
sn12.3:2.1: Which, Monks, is the wrong way?
sn12.3:2.2: ‘Conditioned by ignorance activities come to pass;
sn12.3:2.4: even [the way of] the uprising of this entire mass of ill.
sn12.3:2.5: This is called the wrong way.
sn12.3:3.1: And which is the right way?
sn12.3:3.2: ‘But from the utter fading away and ceasing of ignorance [comes] the ceasing of activities ;
sn12.3:3.3: from the ceasing of activities [comes] ceasing of consciousness”
sn12.3:3.4: even [the way of] the ceasing of this entire mass of ill.
sn12.3:3.5: This is called the right way.
